condition: Since 1.11.22, calling .tz() on an instance throws "formatToParts is not a function" or returns an absurd offset in environments where Intl.DateTimeFormat.prototype.formatToParts is missing or unreliable, such as React Native Hermes on iOS.
workaround: Pin dayjs to 1.11.21, or polyfill Intl.DateTimeFormat (for example with @formatjs/intl-datetimeformat) so that formatToParts works.
